result.brief: 提出可逆、曝光等变的 HDR 编码 EquivFlow，将曝光变化映射为潜空间加性平移并保留色度分量，改善冻结 VAE 的暗部色度传输，用于 SDR-to-HDR 视频扩散重建。
result.reason: Analyzes how HDR signals pass through pretrained image/video VAEs and proposes an invertible exposure-equivariant latent encoding, a concrete contribution to generative latent space design.
